    Audit Senior Specialist

    About Us

    Nu is one of the largest digital financial platforms in the world, with more than 127 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Guided by our mission to fight complexity and empower people, we are redefining financial services in Latin America and this is still just the beginning of the purple future we're building.

    Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: NU), we combine proprietary technology, data intelligence, and an efficient operating model to deliver financial products that are simple, accessible, and human.

    Our impact has been recognized by global rankings such as Time 100 Companies, Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, and Forbes World’s Best Bank. Visit our institutional page https://international.nubank.com.br/careers/

    About the role

    You will be the statutory Head of Internal Audit for Nubank's European entity and the primary Internal Audit point of contact for the local regulator. As Nubank builds its regulated European operation, independent assurance is what earns and keeps the trust of the regulator and the governance bodies — you own that from day one.

    This is not a role that supervises other people doing the work. It is a full hands-on, build-from-scratch role: for the first 12–18 months you will operate largely on your own, performing and leading the audits yourself, with the support of Nubank's global Internal Audit team and additional resources over time as the function matures. You'll report functionally into Nubank's global Internal Audit leadership, preserving Internal Audit's independence and maintaining direct access to the entity's Audit and Risk Committees.

    You will build a modern, data-driven audit function — one that leans on automation, analytics and AI rather than traditional checklist auditing — while partnering with a young, fast-scaling business where governance and controls are still being built. Your goal: stand up and run a credible Internal Audit function that gives the Committees and the local regulator confidence that Nubank is growing in a healthy, sustainable way.

    You'll be responsible for

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

Why You Should Apply NOW:

Are you a passionate, solutions-oriented attorney looking for a new role in a fast-paced financial tech company? Joining YipitData’s legal team is a rare opportunity to become a core contributor to the success of a company that is building the future of investment research.

At YipitData, our Legal team is an essential and collaborative partner in the Company’s growth. As Product Counsel, you will be a core player in the Compliance pillar of the Legal team partnering with our Product team to advise on product and data legal matters from early-stage ideation through launch.

As Our Product Counsel, You Will:

  • Partner with our Corporate Product and Engineering teams from early-stage ideation through late-stage launch, advising on legal and compliance considerations throughout the product development lifecycle, while also supporting other product teams and cross-functional initiatives as business needs evolve.
  • Conduct compliance reviews of new and existing product features, ensuring they meet applicable legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements before and after launch.
  • Advise on the data lifecycle and data pipeline, from sourcing to ingestion through processing, storage, and use, working closely with technical teams to identify and resolve legal risk early.

  • Navigate novel product and data issues in a rapidly changing environment and help build practical, scalable frameworks as the product and data footprint grows.

  • You have a JD or equivalent law degree and are admitted to practice and in good standing in at least one U.S. state.
  • You have at least 4 years of experience as a practicing attorney at a law firm or in-house, advising on product and technology matters. Experience with data pipelines and data-driven businesses is a plus.

This is an exciting opportunity for a law firm associate or in-house product/technology attorney at a high-growth tech or data product company, with strong communication skills and impeccable judgment.

This is a remote-friendly opportunity that can sit in NYC (where our headquarters is located), one of our office hubs (Austin, Cupertino, Los Angeles, and Miami), or anywhere else in the US. However, depending upon where the remote work is performed, income could be subject to New York State tax withholding.

What We Offer:

  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust.
  • The final compensation package for this role may be determined by a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal team benchmarks.

About the role

You help make our customers’ content work in every market by owning the linguistic quality of the accounts you look after. You work with customers, Language Leads, delivery teams, and colleagues in Community Management, and you report to the Language Quality Manager. You own your account quality plans, make decisions within your scope, and coordinate the people involved with minimal oversight. You’ll measure success by whether our customers’ content works, not just whether it was delivered.

What you'll do

  • Own the account quality plan within agreed program direction, turning customer needs into acceptance criteria, risk-based review coverage, and clear responsibilities across human and AI-assisted workflows.
  • Advise customers on quality findings and practical trade-offs, resolve routine queries, and share emerging risks and limitations early through agreed account channels.
  • Put approved evaluation and sampling plans into practice with qualified Language Leads, compare automated quality signals with human findings, and flag omissions, unsupported additions, terminology failures, and context loss.
  • Investigate quality issues, coordinate corrective actions, check whether later deliveries improve, involve Senior Account Quality Managers for complex diagnosis, and escalate material risks or decisions outside your authority.
  • Keep linguistic assets ready with Language Leads and delivery teams, including source-content analysis, current terminology, style guidance, reference materials, and consistent instructions across customer and Acclaro platforms.
  • Coordinate and train Language Leads and reviewers on account requirements, calibration, and approved processes, and work with Community Management on linguist suitability.
  • Support onboarding and workflow transitions by checking linguistic readiness, handovers, and evaluation evidence, monitor the agreed workflow after changes, use approved tools and permitted data, and get the required quality, technical, commercial, and client approvals before changes affect review coverage, data handling, or commitments.

What you'll bring

  • typically 5+ years of progressive experience in localization quality or language services, including managing account-level linguistic quality, or equivalent experience
  • practical knowledge of linguistic QA, terminology, human translation, machine translation, and AI-assisted workflows, including how to read automated quality signals alongside human evaluation and follow approved-tool and data-handling rules
  • the ability to analyze problems, identify root causes, and coordinate practical solutions with global, cross-functional teams
  • experience organizing several accounts or projects, keeping records and assets accurate, and reprioritizing or raising risks early when deadlines or requirements change
  • clear written and spoken English for explaining linguistic requirements, quality findings, and recommended actions to customers and colleagues
  • constructive working relationships with customers, linguists, and delivery teams, with close attention to detail and clear follow-through

Nice to have

  • experience working with enterprise clients or strategic accounts
  • experience supporting account transitions, onboarding, or process design
  • experience training, coaching, or mentoring linguistic teams
  • a degree in linguistics, languages, translation studies, or a related field

If you have some of these, great. If you don’t, we’d still like to hear from you.

Who we are

Acclaro is a content intelligence solutions company, helping global brands communicate with purpose and precision in every market. We bring together the strategy, expertise, and technology organizations need to shape multilingual content that earns trust, connects with buyers, and drives measurable international growth.

With offices around the globe and a team of top talent, we’re committed to being a true strategic partner to the world’s leading companies. In all we do, we remain grounded in our values, as we help make our customers’ content work everywhere.

How we work

About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

Care Access is looking for a Senior Product Manager to help build the future of clinical trials. You will dive deeply into complex industry problems and turn early opportunities into practical, scalable solutions that make clinical research more accessible and effective for people participating in research and for the teams running it.

This is not simply a backlog-management role. We need a navigator who is comfortable with evolving priorities, can step into ambiguous spaces and develop a clear perspective on the problems worth solving, and can bring partners across business, operations, engineering, and design together to move solutions forward. Some solutions will be software products; others will improve processes or ways of working. As a hands-on product leader with a builder mindset, you will use discovery, prototyping, workflow design, and AI-enabled tools to drive practical, measurable impact.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Frames and Prioritizes Complex Problems: Builds deep understanding of business needs, users, workflows, and strategic context. Identifies meaningful opportunities, develops a clear point of view on the problems worth solving, clarifies tradeoffs, and helps focus product investment where it can create the greatest value.
  • Leads End-to-End Product Development: Leads the definition, development, and launch of high-impact products and capabilities. Determines the appropriate mix of software, workflow, process, and operational change needed to solve a problem, balancing near-term progress with durable, scalable capability.
  • Leads Cross-Functional Delivery and Alignment: Builds strong partnerships across business, operations, engineering, design, member services, and site-facing teams. Creates alignment around shared outcomes, communicates decisions clearly, manages dependencies, and moves work from ambiguity to action.
  • Measures Outcomes and Communicates Strategy: Defines success measures, evaluates product and business performance, and uses evidence to guide iteration and investment decisions. Communicates strategy, progress, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to stakeholders and executive leadership.

The Expertise Required

  • Business and User Understanding: Builds context quickly across business priorities, users, workflows, and market dynamics. Uses this understanding to identify opportunities and make sound product decisions.
  • Strong Product Sense and Strategic Problem Solving: Frames ambiguous problems clearly, develops a perspective on what matters most, evaluates competing opportunities, and makes sound tradeoffs. Balances immediate needs with longer-term strategic value.
  • Hands-On Product Leadership and Builder Mindset: Has experience leading product work from discovery through delivery and iteration. A builder mindset means turning insight into progress: testing ideas, creating lightweight prototypes or workflow designs, using AI and modern product tools to accelerate learning, and giving engineering and design clear direction to deliver scalable solutions. This role does not require production coding, but it does require a practical, resourceful approach to moving work forward.
  • Whole-System Problem Solving: Looks beyond a software-only answer to understand the people, processes, and technology shaping a problem. Uses product judgment to recommend the most effective solution, whether that is a new product capability, a workflow improvement, an operational change, or a combination of approaches.
  • Adaptability and Initiative: Thrives in an evolving environment. Is a proactive self-starter who can enter new problem spaces quickly, navigate ambiguity, and maintain momentum.
  • AI Fluency and Curiosity: Is interested in using AI and modern product tools to improve research, synthesis, prototyping, communication, and delivery. Brings curiosity about thoughtful AI-enabled product opportunities.
  • Impact Orientation: Focuses on meaningful business and user outcomes, not simply project completion. Defines success measures, learns from results, and iterates based on evidence.
  • Excellent Communication: Is an active listener who communicates with clarity, conciseness, and impact in writing and conversation. Can simplify complexity, align diverse stakeholders, and confidently present to executive leadership.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

  • Minimum Education:
    • Bachelors’ Degree
  • Minimum Experience:
    • 6+ years in product management, ideally in tech.

How We Work Together

  • Location: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.
  • Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.
  • Physical demands associated with this position Include: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $120,000 - $160,000 USD per year for full time team members.

Benefits & Perks (US Full Time Employees)

  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and Company Paid Holidays
  • 100% Employer paid medical, dental, and vision insurance plan options
  • Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Bi-weekly HSA employer contribution
  • Company paid Short-Term Disability and Long-Term Disability
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan, with Company Match

Mandatory Employer Disclosures

AN EMPLOYER WHO VIOLATES THIS LAW IS GUILTY OF A MISDEMEANOR AND SUBJECT TO A FINE NOT EXCEEDING $100.

Diversity & Inclusion

We work with and serve people from diverse cultures and communities around the world. We are stronger and better when we build a team representing the communities we support. We maintain an inclusive culture where people from a broad range of backgrounds feel valued and respected as they contribute to our mission.

Position Title: Senior Motion Designer (Contractor)

Department: Marketing and Communications

Reports to: Creative Director

Location: Remote

Hourly Range: $70.00 - $80.00/hour

Formerly the Mental Health Association of New York City (MHA-NYC), Vibrant Emotional Health’s groundbreaking solutions have delivered high quality services and support, when, where and how people need it for over 50 years. Through our state-of-the-art technology-enabled services, community wellness programs, and advocacy and education work, we are building a society in which emotional wellness can be a reality for everyone.


Position Overview:

The Senior Motion Designer leads the creation of visually stunning animations and provides strategic creative direction for bringing static content to life across all organizational platforms. This role requires advanced technical expertise, creative leadership capabilities, and the ability to mentor team members while managing complex, multi-phase animation projects. The Senior Motion Designer collaborates with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to conceptualize, design, and execute high-quality animations that effectively communicate strategic organizational messages. This position demands exceptional creative vision, proven project management skills, and the capacity to drive innovation in motion design practices while maintaining the highest standards of visual communication across multiple brands and platforms.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic creative concepting sessions and provide expert input on visual storytelling approaches for complex organizational initiatives
  • Mentor junior designers and provide advanced technical guidance to team members on motion design best practices and skill development
  • Serve as primary creative liaison with external agencies and vendors on motion design projects, ensuring quality and brand alignment
  • Lead development of brand guidelines specifically for motion design standards across all Vibrant properties and organizational communications
  • Collaborates with the creative team to concept and execute designs across various channels and multiple brands. Works on projects for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, ad campaigns, partnerships, internal/external communications and more, covering Vibrant Emotional Health, 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline, the Disaster Distress Helpline, the Veterans Crisis Line, the NFL Life Line as well as other Vibrant properties.
  • Research and implement cutting-edge motion design technologies, AI tools, and industry innovations to enhance organizational creative capabilities
  • Lead complex, multi-phase animation projects requiring advanced technical skills and strategic creative direction
  • Provide technical troubleshooting and problem-solving support for team's motion design challenges and complex production issues
  • Creates static designs and/or works with assets provided by other designers/agencies, and brings those designs to life through motion. Works on both motion graphics that enhance live-action videos (lower thirds, intros/outros, spot animations etc.) as well as fully animated productions (explainers, logo animations, looping GIFs, animated infographics, Lottie animations etc.) whenever that might make sense, to help drive the brand or campaign narrative.
  • Establish and maintain comprehensive motion design templates, asset libraries, and workflow standards for organizational efficiency
  • Lead project management for large-scale motion design initiatives across multiple brands and stakeholder groups
  • Participates in brainstorming sessions, actively contributes creative ideas and execute upon those ideas.
  • Conduct quality control reviews and ensure all motion content meets brand standards and technical specifications
  • Coordinate with multiple stakeholders and manage competing project priorities with strategic oversight
  • Helps manage project files, ensuring all assets, working files and deliverables are organized and up-to-date.
  • Lead crisis production efforts when urgent motion design needs arise under tight deadlines
  • Collaborate directly with senior leadership on strategic visual communication initiatives and organizational branding
  • Ensures that all work is completed within the given timeframe and meets project requirements/specifications.
  • Work closely with video production team to integrate motion graphics into complex productions and multimedia content
  • Lead training initiatives for non-design team members on motion design best practices and organizational brand standards
  • Stays up-to-date with industry trends, techniques and technologies (particularly artificial intelligence) to continuously improve design skills and abilities. Leverages appropriate software scripts and plugins.
  • Represent creative team in cross-departmental strategic planning meetings and organizational initiatives
  • Manage relationships with freelance motion designers and external creative resources to support organizational needs
  • Contributes to the overall success of the team by maintaining open communication, collaborating effectively with team members and taking/giving constructive feedback
  • Optimize workflows to maximize efficiency and reduce production timelines while maintaining quality standards
  • Assists with other duties and responsibilities as assigned by the Creative Manager.

  • Familiar with a range of motion design, animation & compositing techniques and is willing to continuously build upon this range through learning & exploration.
  • Deep understanding of the principles of animations and how to apply them.
  • A keen eye for design; strong grasp of design fundamentals such as composition, typography, color, etc.
  • Basic understanding of video and audio production techniques or is willing to learn
  • Knowledge of web and mobile design and animation principles and experience with Lottie animations is a plus
  • Understand the look, feel and voice of various Vibrant properties and continuously push forward branding guidelines, particularly for motion
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment, take direction and feedback constructively. Be able to communicate ideas, progress updates, and results clearly on a regular basis

Who We Are

Everyday Electric (formerly Renew Home) is on a mission to change how we power the world by making it easier for customers to save energy and money at home as part of the largest residential virtual power plant in North America.

We partner with industry-leading brands to better manage residential energy for users by prioritizing efficiency, savings, and comfort — and cleaner energy for everyone.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer striving to create a diverse, equitable, and inclusive work environment where everyone feels that they have a voice that is heard.

We strongly encourage candidates to check out our website at to learn more about the world-changing work we are doing.

Role Summary

We are hiring a Senior Director, Program Management Office (PMO) to lead the team that delivers some of Everyday Electric's most critical cross-functional work. Reporting to the COO, you will own the PMO's strategy, operating model, and people, and be accountable for how the company plans, prioritizes, and executes its portfolio of programs across BD, Sales and strategic initiatives. Your scope will continue to evolve as the company grows.

As Everyday Electric grows, expanding our offerings and bringing on more customers and partners, our work is becoming more complex and more interconnected. The PMO sits at the center of how the company operates, partnering with business units across the company to bring structure, visibility, and accountability to complex work. You will lead a team of Associate Program Managers, Program Managers, and Senior Program Managers, set the standard for how the PMO operates, and serve as a trusted advisor to executive leadership on prioritization, governance, and tradeoffs, aligning delivery with Everyday Electric's ambitious growth and strategic objectives.

What You Will Do

  • PMO Strategy & Leadership: Define the vision, operating model, and multi-year roadmap for the PMO. Set priorities for the team, align its work to company strategy, and measure the PMO's impact on delivery speed, predictability, and quality.
  • Team Building & Development: Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team. Set clear expectations by level, coach leaders, and build a bench of future PMO leaders.
  • Program Management Oversight: Hold the PMO accountable for the day-to-day alignment and delivery of complex, cross-functional programs. Assign program leads, review program health, and step in on the highest-stakes initiatives.
  • Portfolio Management & Governance: Own the company's portfolio management and stage gate processes, including program intake, prioritization, key documentation, and the information leaders need to make decisions. Evolve governance frameworks, evaluation criteria, and gate readiness standards as the business scales.
  • Resource & Capacity Planning: Maintain enterprise-wide visibility into resourcing across the portfolio. Surface capacity constraints and competing demands early, and help executives make informed tradeoffs.
  • Risk & Dependency Management: Anticipate portfolio-level risks, critical path dependencies, and cross-program conflicts. Escalate with clear recommendations and drive timely resolution.
  • Executive Partnership & Cross-functional Leadership: Partner with functional leaders across Sales, Partnerships, Operations, Finance, and Legal, and with Product and Engineering, to define scope, clarify roles, and align resourcing to company priorities.
  • Executive Communication: Provide clear, concise, and regular reporting on portfolio health, risks, and milestones to executive leadership and the Board as needed.
  • Transition & Handoff Standards: Set the standard for how and when programs move to steady-state ownership, and work with business unit leaders to ensure clean handoffs.
  • Process & Tooling Improvement: Continuously improve project management processes, tools, and best practices across the full program lifecycle, from intake through delivery and handoff.
  • Planning, Financial & Analytical Leadership: Partner with Finance on annual operating and long-range planning cycles. Ensure program, resourcing, and cost inputs are rigorous, pressure-test the assumptions behind plans and models, and shape tradeoff recommendations for the executive team.
  • Own major company communications like our weekly All Hands meeting, as well as support on monthly and quarterly reporting to our investors and board of directors.

Requirements

You set the direction for how the company plans and delivers its most important work, build the team and the systems to do it, and are accountable for the results.

  • Experience: 10+ years in program management, project management, PMO, strategy, or operations roles, including 4+ years leading teams and managing managers. Deep expertise in operational strategy, business development, sales. Hardware experience a plus.
  • Industry knowledge: Experience in energy, cleantech, or a related technology sector is strongly preferred. Experience in a high-growth or startup environment is a strong plus.
  • Financial & analytical acumen: Strong business and financial judgment, including experience with budgeting, business cases, and planning cycles. Financial modeling experience is a plus.
  • Strong collaboration, influencing, and stakeholder management skills, with credibility at the executive level across diverse, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional programs and portfolios in technical, regulated, or multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical and business ideas for diverse audiences.
  • High intellectual curiosity, resourcefulness, self-motivation, and integrity.
  • Able to adapt quickly to changing priorities and tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

Benefits

What You'll Get

  • A full-time position, with a competitive salary based on experience. The base salary for this role is $200k - $250k. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for a target annual bonus of 25% of base salary, and participation in long-term incentive programs tied to company growth and performance. We use market data and consider your job family, background, skills, experience, and U.S. work location to determine compensation within our established pay range.
  • Fully remote work environment with home office set-up allowance.
  • Competitive benefits package that includes numerous health and wellness benefits.
  • 401(k) plan, with employer contributions to the same.
  • Opportunity to work with amazing people who are passionate about their mission, thriving in a fully-remote work environment, and learning and growing every day.

About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We’re currently hiring Senior Account Executives across multiple Inspira Education Group brands.

We’re looking for a driven, entrepreneurial Senior Account Executive with a strong ownership mindset. Someone who thrives in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment and is eager to help students achieve their academic dreams. You’ll play a key role in driving revenue growth through inbound sales, while also helping to build and refine the systems and processes that will allow our sales function to scale in the future.

This is one of the most impactful roles at Inspira. As the first point of contact for parents and students exploring our programs, you’ll set the tone for their entire experience. The trust, empathy, and expertise you bring to these conversations often become the deciding factors in their choice to work with us. You’ll guide them through one of the most meaningful decisions of their lives- investing in their education and future success.

What You'll Do

  • Lead consultative intro calls (inbound) with parents and students to understand their goals, explain the admissions process, and recommend the right Inspira programs and packages based on their needs
  • Own the relationship with prospective students and families from first touch through enrollment by building trust, offering guidance, and ensuring a smooth and positive experience throughout their journey
  • Follow up strategically and consistently to stay connected with prospects, anticipate questions or concerns, and help them confidently decide to partner with Inspira
  • Experiment and innovate—test new scripts, refine messaging, and explore creative follow-up strategies to maximize conversion rates and continuously improve the enrollment experience
  • Close deals across a range of programs and services, meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly sales goals
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with the marketing, counseling, and finance teams to ensure seamless handoffs, strong alignment, and an exceptional customer experience
  • Stay informed on competitor offerings and market trends; provide real-time feedback to founders and leadership to shape product, pricing, and go-to-market strategy
  • Leverage HubSpot CRM to manage the full sales cycle—tracking leads, logging communications, creating email templates, forecasting revenue, and maintaining data integrity across all stages
  • Forecast enrollments accurately by managing deal stages, values, and close dates in HubSpot
  • Support onboarding and customer success for newly enrolled students to ensure a strong start and high satisfaction

Who You Are

  • 3–5 years of experience in inbound sales within a service-oriented or consultative environment, ideally with sales cycles under 2–3 months
  • Proven success selling premium or high-value service packages (ACV $5,000+), with a track record of exceeding targets and delivering exceptional client experiences
  • Excellent communication skills. You’re confident presenting, writing, and speaking with clarity, empathy, and professionalism
  • Strong CRM proficiency, preferably in HubSpot (or similar tools), with a knack for maintaining clean data and using systems to drive performance

  • Nice to Have: Prior experience in education, admissions, or academic consulting sales

What We Value

As a fast-growing startup, every team member plays a pivotal role in shaping our culture and driving our success. At Inspira, we’re looking for people who embody these core values:

  • Winning Attitude: You find a way to succeed. You dig deeper to understand the “why” behind a no, and you don’t stop until you’ve found a solution
  • Curiosity: You constantly push yourself to learn, experiment, and improve. You’re open to new ideas and you see setbacks as opportunities to grow
  • Genuine Relationships: You lead with empathy and integrity. Parents and students trust us with one of the most important decisions of their lives, and you honor that by building authentic, human connections
  • Smart and Hard Work: You combine awareness and judgment with effort and discipline. You know when to think strategically and when to roll up your sleeves
  • Humility and Teamwork: You celebrate collective success over individual wins. You welcome feedback, learn from mistakes, and support those around you

Why you'll love Inspira

  • Mission-driven team culture focused on student success
  • Your work directly impacts the lives and careers of students across the globe

  • Pre-tax benefits (FSA, DCFSA, HSA, Commuter)

Compensation

Founding Full-Stack Engineer

Build the software systems around planqor.ai: the real-time decision layer that steers discrete manufacturing when production plans get disrupted. Born on the shop floor, co-founded by senior production experts, and with direct access to high-impact industry problems. Work directly with our CTO and shape a greenfield product spanning Python backend, data, visualization, frontend, infrastructure, and integration with our optimization core. Backed by investors who have built and scaled successful companies. Remote-first or from our office in Munich, competitive pay + VSOP, no puzzle interviews.

The opportunity

Factories have invested billions in automation, yet production is still steered largely by people. Every night, a plan is computed for the next day, and the first disruption makes it obsolete. From then on, planners and shift leads juggle dependencies by hand. That is expensive, rarely optimal, and wastes much of what these factories were built for.

We are building the layer that takes over when the plan gets disrupted. It connects to factory data, models production, detects disruptions and bottlenecks as they emerge, simulates responses and recommends the best one.

About us

planqor.ai was born on the shop floor. Our founding team brings deep production expertise, strong industry networks. We have the runway to build deliberately and the experience of people who have built and scaled successful companies before. On the technical side, we combine deep algorithmic and software-engineering competence with modern optimization methods, GenAI-assisted development and fast, pragmatic iteration. We are in stealth and very early, which means you can shape much of what comes next.

What you'll own

  • The product layer: Turn complex optimization systems into software planners can actually use.

  • Backend and data: Build Python services, APIs, data models, and pipelines around our optimization engine.

  • Interfaces and visualization: Make schedules, bottlenecks, dependencies, and alternative decisions understandable and interactive.

  • Integration: Connect native C++ components, factory data, and product workflows into one coherent system.

  • Infrastructure: Own CI/CD, containers, deployment, observability, and the supporting services we need.

  • The team: Grow into leading software engineering at planqor.ai as we scale: hiring, mentoring, and setting direction.

You set your own priorities and structure your work toward clear goals. No ticket queue, no micromanagement.

How we build

Our product sits at the boundary between algorithms, software systems, and real industrial operations.

We care about building systems that are easy to integrate, responsive, understandable, and maintainable as both the product and the underlying algorithms evolve.

We use GenAI extensively to prototype, implement, and explore alternatives. But generating code is not the hard part. The value lies in designing the right system, choosing good abstractions, validating behavior, and knowing what is worth building.

There are no points for cleverness. The simplest system that reliably solves the real problem wins.

What you'll bring

  • Strong Python and backend engineering. You are comfortable designing APIs, services, libraries, and maintainable system boundaries.

  • Full-stack product skills. You can work with TypeScript, React, or similar technologies and build interfaces that make complex systems understandable.

  • Data and integration. You can design data models and pipelines, work with databases, and connect messy external systems to clean internal interfaces.

  • Systems thinking. You think beyond individual services or screens: how data, algorithms, product, and infrastructure fit together.

  • Infrastructure fundamentals. You are comfortable with Docker, CI/CD, deployment, observability, and operating services.

  • Independence. You can turn an underspecified operational problem into working software without waiting for a detailed spec.

  • Fluent English. German and experience in manufacturing or industrial planning are useful but not required.

Bonus: C++ and native Python bindings such as pybind11 or nanobind; data visualization; optimization, scheduling, simulation, or other algorithmic systems; enterprise integrations such as ERP / SAP.

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: shape the product architecture from line one, working directly with our CTO.

  • A clear growth path into leading the software engineering team.

  • A real problem worth solving.

  • We equip you with the hardware, compute, and tools you work best with.

  • Remote-first or from our Munich office, with regular in-person workshops.

  • Competitive pay + VSOP.

The process (fast, real conversations, no puzzles)

  1. Send your CV.

  2. Talk with our CTO about your work and how you approach hard problems.

  3. Meet our CEO and selected investors.

Sumsub is the first AI-powered trust infrastructure for compliance operations at scale. It connects identity and business verification, fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, and risk workflows, helping teams reduce manual work and enter new markets.

Trusted by over 4,000 clients across financial services, crypto, mobility, trading, marketplaces, education, and iGaming, including Bybit, Bitpanda, Wirex, Avis, Vodafone, Duolingo, Kaizen Gaming, and Bancaribe.

Sumsub is certified as a Great Place To Work® in the US, recognized as a TIME & Statista Excellent Workplace, honored with the TrustRadius Tech Cares Award for Diversity & Inclusion, and rated 4.7 out of 5 on Glassdoor. Our 1,000+ people around the world back it up, too: 92% are proud to be Sumsubers, and 90% say their work is interesting and challenging.

Sumsub is making a major strategic investment in Reusable Identity, and as such, we are expanding our product leadership and engineering capacity in this space.

Reporting directly to the Head of Reusable Identity, you will take end-to-end ownership of Reusable KYC — Gateway, an innovative, early-stage product with strong market demand and nothing quite like it on the market.

We have proven product-market fit with early adopters in crypto and iGaming, and now our goal is to scale rapidly. You will work alongside a growing, AI-forward engineering team as well as analytics, commercial, and executive teams.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Take full ownership of the product strategy, roadmap, and execution, driving adoption from early traction to multiple complex integrations.

  • Work hands-on with customers and ecosystem partners on a daily basis—joining commercial and technical pitches alongside senior leadership, talking directly with C-level/senior stakeholders, and translating complex integration needs into scalable product capabilities.

  • Partner closely with commercial and partnerships teams to shape GTM motions, expand partner networks, and unlock new monetization and adoption levers across crypto, iGaming, and broader financial services.

  • Navigate intricate multi-party integration flows, prioritize high-impact work using clear goals and data, and collaborate closely with a growing engineering team (leveraging AI-accelerated workflows) to ship meaningful improvements.

  • Explore and define new opportunities across privacy-preserving identity sharing, and next-generation reusable verification models.

  • Articulate product vision, priorities, and measurable impact across internal leadership, engineering, and external partners with clarity and energy.

About You:

  • 5+ years of B2B Product Management experience, ideally within established, structured product organizations where you have scaled complex B2B products.

  • You are not a developer, but you deeply understand APIs, multi-party integration architectures, and data flows—and can hold your own in technical deep-dives with partner CTOs and engineers.

  • You thrive on day-to-day customer interaction, have a proven track record of working directly with senior client stakeholders, and let real customer discovery shape what gets built.

  • You have taken an early-stage or post-PMF B2B product and scaled its adoption and partner ecosystem using measurable outcomes.

  • Experience in crypto, Web3 wallets, fintech, iGaming, digital identity, or regulated financial services is strongly preferred.

  • You bring clear, structured thinking, engaging communication, and high energy to every room—whether pitching a partner CEO or aligning your engineering Lead.

  • Fluent, near-native English proficiency is required.

What We Offer:

  • Remote-first, trust-based culture. Work from the place that works best for you. No mandatory office days, no attendance trackers. In some locations, we provide offices or coworking spaces, but the choice is yours.

  • True flexibility.We do not fix you to a 9-to-5 schedule. You can adjust your working hours when needed, as long as your day stays productive and in sync with the team.

  • Extra time off. Your birthday is a holiday here. Add to that 10 personal days each year, seven sick days without paperwork, and extra time to enjoy Christmas and New Year. Time to rest is part of the deal.

  • Work that matters.Our mission is to build a digital world that is secure, accessible and inclusive for everyone. From fighting fraud to making online services easier and safer to use, your work will have a real impact on how people experience trust online.

  • Compensation.We offer fair and transparent pay, benchmarked to the market.

  • Truly global.We work across continents and time zones, with teammates and customers from all over the world. You will run campaigns that cross borders, cultures, and languages, and see your ideas land worldwide.

  • Growth built in. Clear goals, open feedback and personal development plans. We support your progress with learning opportunities and by covering role-specific events, from design conferences to marketing forums.

  • Celebrating your big moments.We are proud to support you through life’s biggest journeys with dedicated financial bonuses for both marriage and welcoming a new baby to your family.

  • Team offsites. Sometimes just Slack is not enough. That is why we meet in person a few times a year. Trips are fully covered, so you can meet, collaborate, and recharge together.

  • Getting you set up. We make sure you have access to the tools and hardware you need to do your work well.

  • Friendly by design.Our logo is a dog for a reason. We keep things human, open and kind. We welcome individuality, quirks and different perspectives, because that is what makes our work smarter and more fun.

The hiring stages:TA screening -> Interview with Head of Reusable Identity -> Product Challenge (Case Study) with Head of Reusable Identity and Senior Backend Engineer -> Final Interview with CTO/CPO

Sounds like a great opportunity for your career development? Then go ahead and apply!

We are a global community of innovators, creators, and thinkers, and we believe that diversity fuels our innovation. Sumsub is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Join us in shaping the future inclusively.

We believe in fair and transparent compensation. Salaries vary depending on work location and applicable local market conditions.

This role is open to candidates in multiple countries, and compensation differs based on the candidate’s confirmed work location. For this reason, a single universal salary range is not included in this job posting.
The applicable work location will be confirmed early in the recruitment process, and the relevant compensation information for that location will be shared in writing, in line with local requirements.

We're a remote team of around 15 people spread across Europe, the US, Africa, and the Philippines. We believe in autonomy: people manage their own time, and we trust you to get the work done.       <title>OneImaging: Cloud Systems Administrator</title>
      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://oneimaging.com">https://oneimaging.com</a>
</p>

<div><p>Radiology is the second most used healthcare service, used by over 51% of the workforce annually. Despite the critical role of radiology in healthcare, the process for undergoing a medical imaging exam has remained unchanged for decades. OneImaging is solving this with a concierge approach and a premium-quality radiology network of over 5,000 vetted providers across 48 states, which also reduces imaging costs by 60-80%. Our solution helps patients and families access essential radiology services at fair prices and without surprise bills, all while delivering immediate savings and ROI for employers and payers on every exam.</p></div><p>The Systems Administrator owns the day-to-day administration of our SaaS and cloud vendor stack, with security and logging as the first priority. You will manage user&nbsp;access across every platform we use, keep audit logging and security controls configured&nbsp;and reviewed, write scripts to automate repetitive admin work, and act as a first&nbsp;responder on security incidents. You will also provide hands-on IT support to employees.&nbsp;This is a generalist role for someone who likes owning systems end to end: you are the&nbsp;person who knows how each vendor is set up, who has access to what, and where the logs&nbsp;live.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>What you'll do:</strong></p>
<h4><strong>Vendor and SaaS administration (security and logging first)</strong></h4>
<ul>
<li>Serve as the primary administrator for our SaaS and cloud platforms: tenant settings, SSO/SAML and SCIM integration, MFA enforcement, API keys, roles and permissions.</li>
<li>Configure and maintain audit logging on every platform that supports it; centralize logs where possible and make sure retention meets our compliance needs.</li>
<li>Run periodic access reviews, remove stale accounts and over-privileged roles, and keep an accurate inventory of who has admin rights where.</li>
<li>Own the security posture of each vendor: review security settings on new tools before rollout, track vendor security notices, and evaluate new vendor requests for risk.</li>
</ul>
<h4>User lifecycle and identity</h4>
<ul>
<li>Onboard and offboard employees and contractors across all systems the same day, driven from Rippling and Google Workspace, our identity sources of truth.</li>
<li>Manage groups, roles and licenses; keep license counts right-sized and flag waste.</li>
<li>Maintain device enrollment, MDM policies and endpoint security for company laptops.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Scripting and automation</h4>
<ul>
<li>Write and maintain scripts (Python, PowerShell, Bash) and use vendor APIs to automate provisioning, access reviews, log collection and reporting.</li>
<li>Build lightweight integrations between systems (for example, HRIS to identity provider to SaaS) so manual admin work shrinks over time.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Security incident response</h4>
<ul>
<li>Act as a first responder on security alerts: triage, contain (disable accounts, revoke tokens, isolate devices), gather evidence from logs, and escalate.</li>
<li>Participate in post-incident reviews and implement the fixes that come out of them.</li>
<li>Help maintain and test our incident response and business continuity runbooks.</li>
</ul>
<h4>IT support</h4>
<ul>
<li>Provide tier 1–2 support to employees: hardware, accounts, access, video conferencing, printers and office network.</li>
<li>Procure, image and manage laptops and peripherals; keep an asset inventory current.</li>
<li>Write and keep up internal how-to documentation so common requests become self-service.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Platforms you will administer</h4>
<p>These are our largest software and cloud vendors by spend over the last 12 months. Deep experience with the first group is expected; the rest you will pick up on the job.</p>




<p>Area</p>


<p>Platforms</p>




<p>Cloud infrastructure</p>


<p>Amazon Web Services (IAM, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub)</p>




<p>Identity, HR and devices</p>


<p>Rippling (HRIS, SSO, device management) and Google Workspace, used together as our identity source of truth</p>




<p>Productivity and email</p>


<p>Google Workspace (admin console, Vault, security center)</p>




<p>Customer support and CRM</p>


<p>Zendesk, Salesforce, Intercom</p>




<p>Communications</p>


<p>Zoom, Aircall, Twilio</p>




<p>Data and engineering</p>


<p>Databricks, MongoDB Atlas, Sentry, Linear, Postman, Stytch</p>




<p>AI platforms</p>


<p>Anthropic, OpenAI (API key and usage management)</p>




<p>Collaboration and design</p>


<p>Notion, Lucid, Figma, Adobe, Scribe</p>




<p>Security tools</p>


<p>NordVPN Teams, Virtru (email encryption)</p>




<p>Healthcare operations</p>


<p>Waystar, AdvancedMD</p>




<p>Marketing and recruiting</p>


<p>Braze, ActiveCampaign, Greenhouse, LinkedIn</p>




<p><strong>About you:</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>3+ years administering SaaS and cloud platforms in a company of 50–500 people, including Google Workspace and an identity/HR platform like Rippling or Okta, and ideally AWS.</li>
<li>Hands-on experience configuring SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, MFA policies and role-based access.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of audit logging and log review: you know what a CloudTrail event, a Workspace audit log or a Zendesk audit entry looks like and what to do with it.</li>
<li>Scripting ability in at least one of Python, PowerShell or Bash, and comfort calling REST APIs.</li>
<li>Experience responding to security incidents (phishing, compromised accounts, lost devices) and documenting what happened.</li>
<li>Strong IT support instincts: you communicate clearly with non-technical colleagues and close tickets fast.</li>
<li>Familiarity with HIPAA or a comparable compliance framework (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and what it means for access control and logging.</li>
</ul>
<h4>Nice to have:</h4>
<ul>
<li>AWS Certified SysOps Administrator, Security Specialty, or Google Workspace Administrator certification.</li>
<li>Experience with a SIEM or log aggregation tool (Datadog, Splunk, Google SecOps, or similar) and writing detection rules.</li>
<li>MDM experience (Rippling, Jamf, Kandji, Intune) and macOS/Windows endpoint hardening.</li>
<li>Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for managing AWS and SaaS configuration.</li>
<li>Prior work in a healthcare or other regulated company.</li>
<li>Experience administering API usage and keys for AI platforms (Anthropic, OpenAI) and setting spend and access controls.</li>
</ul>
<p><em>The base salary range for this position is $60,000 - $75,000. Individual compensation will depend on various factors, including qualifications, skills, experience, location, and applicable laws. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible to participate in our equity incentive and competitive benefits plans.&nbsp;</em></p><div><h5><span><strong>Fraud and Security Notice:&nbsp;</strong></span></h5>
<p><span><em>Please be aware of recent job scam attempts. Our team uses the <a href="oneimaging.com">oneimaging.com</a>&nbsp;email domain exclusively. If you have been contacted by someone claiming to be a OneImaging recruiter or a hiring manager from a different domain about a potential job, please report it to law enforcement <a href="https://www.ic3.gov/Home/ComplaintChoice">here</a>&nbsp;and to&nbsp;<a href="mailto:candidateprotection@oneimaging.com">candidateprotection@oneimaging.com</a>.</em></span></p>
<h5><span><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity:</strong></span></h5>
<p><span><em>OneImaging is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and values diversity in the workplace. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</em></span></p>
<p><span><em>OneImaging is committed to providing accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at <a href="mailto:talent@oneimaging.com">talent@oneimaging.com</a>.&nbsp;</em></span></p></div>

<p><strong>To apply:</strong> <a href="https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oneimaging-cloud-systems-administrator">https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/oneimaging-cloud-systems-administrator</a></p>
</description>

      <region>Anywhere in the World</region>
      <category>Back-End Programming</category>
      <description><img src="https://we-work-remotely.imgix.net/logos/0171/6696/logo.gif?ixlib=rails-4.0.0&w=50&h=50&dpr=2&fit=fill&auto=compress" />

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> New Jersey, USA
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://vertican.com">https://vertican.com</a>
</p>

<h2>About the role</h2>
<p>For 40 years Vertican has buildt software that runs law firms. One year ago we created a new modern AI platform for document automation (processing/extraction/redacting) which our customers have been adopting faster than any product we've ever had. Our suite of AI-enabled products save customers thousands of hours each week by processing high volumes of documents with precision and speed.The AI team is growing and we'd like you to join.</p>
<p>We are hiring an engineer to own the document processing pipelines end to end: design, benchmarking, experimenting with new architectures and tools, threshold required for deploying a new pipeline, etc.</p>
<p>We believe it's important to build our own tooling to help us run, improve, and measure our applications. Therefore, the ideal candidate thinks outside the box on how to not just build the product/pipeline, but also the tooling needed around it.</p>
<p>You will be the first dedicated ML hire on the product taking over from the engineering manager who build the current solution and will work directly with the founding engineering team.</p>
<p>This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role, but we are small team and you'll be involved in design, planning, roadmapping, and architectural decisions.</p>
<h2>What you will do</h2>
<p><strong>Design the pipelines.</strong> Own the architecture of the extraction-to-posting pipelines: page classification, field extraction, candidate retrieval, claim matching, confidence gating and the hand-off to human review, etc. Decide where rules end and models begin, and what each stage must guarantee to the next, what the separation of concerns are, etc.</p>
<p>We have different pipelines for different document types and expect that at any given point in time we may have new ones emerge and may consolidate others.</p>
<p><strong>Evaluate new systems before we adopt them.</strong> Run structured trials of candidate components and recommend what to keep. Examples include probabilistic record linkage (Splink), Azure AI Content Understanding and Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI and Foundry-hosted models, and LLM agents with tools. Similarly, test new models with the existing pipeline as they are relased from the frontier labs.</p>
<p><strong>Build the evaluation process.</strong> You'll own the process of evaluating false positives, false negatives, errors of ommission, etc, that we ultimately use to determine if we should upgrade the pipeline.&nbsp;</p>
<p><strong>Ship and operate.</strong> Take components from trial to production in our python workers on the cloud, instrument them, watch cost and quota, and diagnose the cases reviewers send back.</p>
<p><strong>Set direction.</strong> Work with leadereship on the planing for accuracy, cost improvement, and overall product improvements.</p>
<h2>What we are looking for</h2>
<p><strong>Required</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>6+ years building ML or data-intensive systems, at least 3 of them owning a production pipeline whose output people acted on.</li>
<li>Solid backend engineering understanding and ideally cloud architecture understanding.</li>
<li>Ideally hands-on experience with document understanding: OCR or layout models, field extraction from scanned PDFs, or intelligent document processing products.</li>
<li>Experience with entity resolution or record linkage at scale (Splink, Dedupe, Zingg, or your own blocking-and-scoring system) against databases of hundreds of thousands of rows.</li>
<li>You have designed an evaluation from scratch: built a labeled ground-truth set, chosen the metrics, and defended a threshold to a non-technical stakeholder.</li>
<li>Production experience with LLM APIs, including structured output, tool calling and cost or rate-limit management; you can say when an LLM is the wrong tool.</li>
<li>Strong Python and SQL. Comfortable reading Postgres query plans and writing the raw query when the ORM gets in the way.</li>
<li>Engineering/Scientist mindset: you are scientific about testing the pipeline and how results are interpeted/presented.</li>
</ul>
<p><strong>Nice to have</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Azure AI services (Content Understanding, Document Intelligence, Azure OpenAI, Foundry) or the AWS and GCP equivalents.</li>
<li>Financial document processing: checks, remittance advices, lockbox files, payment matching, or accounts receivable automation.</li>
<li>Exposure to collections, legal operations or other regulated workflows handling PII.</li>
<li>Probabilistic matching theory (Fellegi-Sunter) or active-learning labeling workflows.</li>
<li>Experience building human-review tooling or feedback loops that feed back into training and evaluation data.</li>
</ul>
<h2>How we work and what we offer</h2>
<p>Small team, direct access to large datasets, weekly planning, daily standup, everyone remote in US timezones.</p>
<p>What we offer:</p>
<ul>
<li>A small team of tight-knit, like-minded people passionate about high quality software</li>
<li>Competitive compensation, commensurate with a senior individual-contributor role.</li>
<li>Monthly payments in USD</li>
</ul>
<p>Vertican is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.</p>

<p>Overview</p><p>A fast-growing AI evaluation company is building expert-level benchmarks that test how well AI agents handle real professional work in the terminal. We are hiring cryptography experts to turn real, paid tasks from their own work into end-to-end challenges for AI agents, each with a working solution and a check that proves the result is correct.</p><p>***THIS IS A TASK BASED COMPENSATION MODEL. PLEASE CHECK THE APPLICATION QUESTIONS FOR MORE DETAILS.***</p><p>Responsibilities</p><p>• Design expert-level Terminal-Bench cryptography tasks by turning real, paid work from your own experience into challenges that an AI agent must solve end to end.</p><p>• Define the task environment, including files, systems, ciphertexts and data, so the challenge is realistic, self-contained and reproducible in a Linux command-line setup.</p><p>• Write a working reference solution in Python or SageMath that proves the task is solvable, for example by recovering a key or decrypting a secret.</p><p>• Build automated checks and tests that objectively verify the final result is correct, and explain how a mistake or a partial answer would be detected.</p><p>• Calibrate task difficulty so a typical expert needs about 60-75 minutes to solve it, keeping it hard for AI agents while still fair and unambiguous.</p><p>• Package each task with Docker and Git where applicable, document instructions clearly, and revise based on reviewer feedback until it meets the required quality bar.</p><p>Skills/Experience</p><p>• 3+ years of hands-on cryptanalysis or applied cryptography; GRC, audit-only, policy, sales or management roles do not count, nor does coursework only</p><p>• Did the work in the last 3 years and can name the systems, tools, data and rules used</p><p>• Uses the low-level tools of the subfield, such as SageMath and Python, and works comfortably on the Linux command line</p><p>• Can show how a finding is proven, such as a decrypted secret or a recovered key, and explain how a mistake would be caught</p><p>• Technical fluency with files, CSV/JSON, APIs or databases</p><p>• Available to start around November 2026</p><p>Nice-to-have</p><p>• Published write-ups or research on cryptanalysis</p><p>• Strong CTF results, especially in crypto categories</p><p>• CVEs discovered in cryptographic implementations</p><p>• Experience with Docker, Git and writing automated tests</p><p>• Proficiency in C for low-level cryptographic work</p><p>Process</p><p>• Task vetting: complete a vetting task instead of a live interview</p><p>• Work is paid per task, with each task taking roughly 60-75 minutes</p><p>• Expected start around early November 2026</p>

<p><strong><span>Senior Software Engineer, eRx Enterprise and Gadget</span></strong></p><h1>About DrFirst</h1><p>For 25 years, DrFirst has empowered providers and patients to achieve better health through intelligent medication management. We improve healthcare workflows and help patients start and stay on therapy with end-to-end solutions that enhance prescription access, affordability, and adherence. Our solutions help 100 million patients a year and are used by more than 420,000 prescribers, 71,000 pharmacies, 270 EHRs and health information systems, and over 2,000 hospitals in the U.S. This is a great opportunity to be a part of a successful Healthcare IT company experiencing significant growth. Here you’ll get to work with some of the smartest and most interesting people around, solving unique and complex challenges in healthcare on a scale matched by few companies. If you get excited about stretching yourself in new ways, developing yourself to your fullest potential, and care about working with smart colleagues, we want to talk to you!</p><h1>Position Overview</h1><p>DrFirst is hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the eRx Enterprise and Gadget team. Your first focus is Gadget, our pharmacy agent. Over time you will extend your work into Rcopia, our ePrescribing platform, on Electronic Prescribing of Controlled Substances (EPCS) and Prescription Drug Monitoring Program (PDMP) workflows.</p><p>You will build cloud native, high performance services for an ePrescribing collaboration platform. The platform connects providers, patients, payers, pharmacies, and pharmaceutical companies in real time. You will design systems built for high load, with self healing, auto scaling, and full observability.</p><p>You bring strong judgment about AI. You know when AI speeds up delivery and when AI produces weak code. You apply AI to raise code quality, performance, and design standards across the team, and you solve real problems for the pharmacies and prescribers who rely on our platform.</p><h1>What You Will Work On</h1><div><ul><li>Build and improve Gadget, the DrFirst pharmacy agent, from design through production.</li><li>Contribute to Rcopia EPCS and PDMP capabilities as the team roadmap expands.</li><li>Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain secure, scalable Java integration solutions.</li><li>Build cloud native microservices on AWS with auto scaling, fault tolerance, high availability, and self healing.</li><li>Develop and maintain integrations with major EHR platforms, including athenaOne, Epic, Oracle Health, Greenway, AdvancedMD, eMDs, and ModMed, using HL7, FHIR, web services, APIs, and Mirth Connect.</li><li>Build and maintain event driven architectures with Apache Kafka for reliable, efficient service communication.</li><li>Deliver high throughput and low latency across large, distributed platforms.</li><li>Partner with DevOps on CI/CD pipelines that automate testing, deployment, and monitoring.</li><li>Design AI powered automation frameworks for faster development cycles and automated regression testing.</li><li>Decide where AI adds value in the codebase and where human design must lead. Set review standards for AI assisted code.</li><li>Monitor, diagnose, and resolve performance issues with observability tools and logs.</li><li>Follow and enforce secure coding practices. Take part in security audits and reviews.</li><li>Lead code reviews, mentor junior developers, and contribute to architecture decisions.</li><li>Track industry trends and improve system performance, resilience, and developer productivity.</li></ul></div><h1>Qualifications</h1><h2>Required</h2><div><ul><li>Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related discipline.</li><li>5+ years of hands on Java development with deep knowledge of object oriented design and the Spring Framework, including Spring Boot and Spring Cloud.</li><li>3+ years designing and building cloud native applications on AWS, including S3, Valkey, Lambda, RDS, and EKS or ECS.</li><li>3+ years with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka, with a solid grasp of event streaming.</li><li>Proven record building and integrating large scale, high performance, distributed systems with fault tolerance, scalability, and low latency.</li><li>AI first mindset, with daily hands on use of AI tools such as Claude and GitHub Copilot for coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.</li><li>Clear judgment on when and where AI improves engineering outcomes, and a record of keeping AI generated code from lowering quality, performance, or design.</li><li>Proficiency building and consuming RESTful APIs with JSON and XML.</li><li>Strong experience with relational or NoSQL databases, including schema design, performance tuning, and query optimization.</li><li>Hands on experience with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as GitLab CI and Jenkins.</li><li>Solid knowledge of application and data security, including authentication, authorization, and data protection.</li><li>Self motivated. You work well on your own in a fast paced, agile environment.</li><li>Fast learner who adapts to new technologies, teams, and environments.</li><li>Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a proactive, solution oriented approach.</li></ul></div><h2>Preferred</h2><div><ul><li>Experience building AI agents, LLM integrations, or agentic workflows in production.</li><li>Experience with large scale, mission critical systems in finance, brokerage, trading, or credit card processing, especially systems requiring low latency, high throughput, and high availability.</li><li>Experience with ePrescribing, EPCS, PDMP, NCPDP SCRIPT, or pharmacy systems.</li><li>Familiarity with front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript).</li></ul></div><h1>Physical Requirements</h1><div><ul><li>Primarily desk work in a remote, U.S. based setting.</li><li>Extended periods of computer use.</li></ul></div><p><strong><span>#LI-GF1 #LI-Remote</span></strong></p><h1>Benefits</h1><div><ul><li>Competitive compensation, with a base salary of $130,000 to $150,000 (Exact compensation may vary based on skills and experience)</li><li>Eligible for a Discretionary Performance-based bonus</li><li>Medical, dental, and vision insurance</li><li>401K eligible after 3 months of employment, with 50% company match up to first 5% of salary contributed to the plan with a 3-year vesting schedule</li><li>HSA for eligible employees enrolled in the HDHP, with a generous company contribution up to $500 for individual coverage and $1000 for family coverage per year</li><li>100% company paid short and long-term disability, AD&amp;D, and group life insurance</li><li>Accrued annual paid time off (PTO) of 18 days for the first 3 years of service, increasing thereafter and 7 paid holiday days</li><li>Employee Assistance Program</li><li>Continuing Education funds up to $1500 annually for eligible programs after 1       <region>USA Only</region>
      <category>Full-Stack Programming</category>
      <description>

<p>
  <strong>Headquarters:</strong> 
    <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="http://cmswa.com">http://cmswa.com</a>
</p>

<div><p>Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress.</p>
<p>If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. &nbsp;We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team.</p></div><h2>About Custom Mechanical Solutions</h2>
<p>Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support.</p>
<p>As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization.</p>
<p><strong>Title:</strong> Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer<br><strong>Department:</strong> CMS National Accounts<br><strong>Location:</strong> Fully remote within the United States<br><strong>Travel:</strong> Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel</p>
<p><strong>Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes.</strong></p>
<p>Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales.</p>
<h1>The opportunity</h1>
<p>CMS is looking for a Quality &amp; Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure.</p>
<p>This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects.</p>
<p>Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions.</p>
<h1>What you will own</h1>
<ul>
<li><strong>Lead field-to-factory investigations. </strong>Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure.</li>
<li><strong>Turn field intelligence into action. </strong>Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation.</li>
<li><strong>Create field-ready solutions. </strong>Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence.</li>
<li><strong>Drive clarity and accountability. </strong>Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed.</li>
<li><strong>Use data to improve the program. </strong>Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners.</li>
<li><strong>Go where the evidence is. </strong>Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness.</li>
</ul>
<h1>You will probably love this role if...</h1>
<ul>
<li>When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer.</li>
<li>You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly.</li>
<li>You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed.</li>
<li>You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved.</li>
<li>You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one.</li>
</ul>
<h1>Required qualifications</h1>
<ul>
<li>A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience.</li>
<li>At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support.</li>
<li>Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills.</li>
<li>Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure.</li>

<div class="content-intro"><p>Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! <p>We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.&nbsp; The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating.&nbsp;</p>
<p>Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit <a href="http://knock.com/">Knock.com</a></p></div><p><strong>Lending Manager (Front End)</strong></p>

<p><strong>Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.</strong></p>
<p><strong>What you’ll do:</strong></p>

<li><strong>Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.</strong></li>
<li><strong>Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.</strong></li>
</ul>
<p><strong><em>Own the pipeline</em></strong></p>
<ul>
